description: This source file defines a REST API controller for managing followers in a social media style application. It provides endpoints to follow and unfollow user profiles.

classes.name: FollowersController
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core MVC controller that handles follow and unfollow actions for user profiles.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to follow a user profile identified by username.

methods.name: Unfollow
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to unfollow a user profile identified by username.
